info.name: Roova Backend — Auth API
info.description: Agency, Admin, and Investor auth endpoints (session-cookie based). Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to point at your running server (defaults to http://localhost:3000). Every request has saved example responses covering the success case and every error case the endpoint can return.
